study.name: People display consistent recency and primacy effects in behavior and neural activity across perceptual and value-based judgments
study.citation: Yoo, M., Bahg, G., Turner, B. et al. (2025). People display consistent recency and primacy effects in behavior and neural activity across perceptual and value-based judgments. Cognitive, Affective, & Behavioral Neuroscience, 25, 923-940.
